# Third-party notices

These notices travel with the SystemVerilog front-end files (`.wasm` and
their JavaScript) that circuit-model's SystemVerilog import may ship (batch
C11). They are assembled by hand from the pinned releases named in
DECISIONS.md ("C11.0b"); the npm package of YoWASP ships no licence texts of
its own. Two bundles are covered: **slang** (our own WebAssembly build) and
**YoWASP Yosys** (the `@yowasp/yosys` package, which contains Yosys and
yosys-slang). Nothing here is ours; our own files carry no licence yet (see
DECISIONS.md).

Where an upstream file is a licence text it is reproduced whole; where a
library states its licence in a source-file header, the header is quoted.
Version 1.0 of the Boost Software License and the MIT and ISC texts are the
standard texts.

## Not covered here

- `ieee1800/vpi_user.h`, `sv_vpi_user.h`, `svdpi.h` and
  `vpi_compatibility.h` come with slang (and the copy inside yosys-slang). The
  files carry no licence statement; see DECISIONS.md ("C11.0b") for the flag to
  the IP Inspector. Only a struct layout from `vpi_user.h` is compiled in.
- slang's `BS_thread_pool.hpp` (MIT) is not built: slang is configured
  without threads. Yosys techlib files (`.v` simulation and mapping models for
  FPGA families) are covered by the Yosys licence above unless a file says
  otherwise; they should be checked by the IP Inspector before the browser
  bundle ships.
